guardrails: Market-wide FII net buying does not reveal which industry bought; never infer a sector purchase from aggregate flow.
Index or ETF price momentum is NOT fund flow or named investor positioning.
Institutional fund flows at different dates/frequencies must not be compared as though contemporaneous.
Country equity funds are a different population from country ETF price moves and Treasury TIC bilateral securities data.
Numbers not verified from dated primary sources or credible reporting remain null, not 0.
Qualitative sector-buying reports are clearly marked as such; exact sector numbers must await disclosure.
